research_summary: Emeritus Professor of Statistics smartphone (617) 495-5462 email chernoff@stat.harvard.edu Professor Chernoff is Professor Emeritus of Applied Mathematics at MIT and of Statistics at Harvard University. He is the co-author, with Lincoln Moses, of a text book, now a Dover Reprint, entitled "Elementary Decision Theory."
